## Summary
This OUI, 0C:C0:C0 (MA-L, registered 8 April 2012), is the only block under this name and belongs to the Mexican electronics subsidiary of Magneti Marelli at Av. Industria 20/21, Tepotzotlan, Estado de Mexico 54600 [1][6]. Magneti Marelli was founded in 1919 as a Fiat/Ercole Marelli joint venture, was a Fiat subsidiary from 1967, and in October 2018 FCA agreed to sell it to KKR for about $7.2 billion to merge with Calsonic Kansei; the merged company has traded as Marelli since May 2019 [2][5]. Marelli Holdings (Saitama, Japan; 58 plants including Mexico) filed for Chapter 11 on 11 June 2025 and was negotiating a sale of its assets as of mid-2026 [3]. The group's electronics line covers body control, instrument clusters, telematics computers and, today, "LeanConnect"/"ProConnect" units that integrate cluster, in-vehicle infotainment and telematics into one box [2][4], so a MAC in 0C:C0:C0 is almost certainly a car: an infotainment head unit or telematics module, appearing on Wi-Fi as a short-lived hotspot AP or as a client joining a home network from the driveway, with Bluetooth alongside. Which vehicle brands carry this block, the radio chipset inside, the FCC grantee code and any security advisories could not be established: Marelli's locations page and the Tepotzotlan plant description were not reachable, DeviWiki has no entry for the prefix and the FCC ID databases were not reachable, so those fields are left unknown rather than inferred from the parent's customer list.
